name: Widescreen
author: byo-pop
description: A 16:9 screen: the game as usual on the left and a panel beside the board on the right, with the words you have played this game (newest first, in the colour of their best special tile) and, with the Word Solver mod, the solver's list for the board: click a word to select it. Play is unchanged, so games keep the usual high scores.
